scope: Theorem 1.2 of the manuscript “Entanglement with zero distillable secret key in local dimension ten” (preprints/Entanglement-with-zero-distillable-secret-key-in-local-dimension-ten-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 272 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 be18f63c5a1d11a2), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are explicitly specified PPT maps Φ1, Φ2 : M10(C) → M10(C) for which Z = J(Φ2 ◦ Φ1) is nonzero and its range contains no nonzero product vector in C10 ⊗ C10. In particular, the composition Φ2 ◦ Φ1 is not entanglement breaking.
